entries.name: Lock the Frame
entries.effect: Before forced movement on solid ground: Stability 3 for that movement.
entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Lock the Frame

*The joints grind shut and the body becomes a single weight planted against the shove.*

Before this creature is forcibly moved while on solid ground, gain Stability 3 for that forced movement only. Use the highest source. In a collision chain, declare before its Stability is deducted; prior collision damage still resolves. This does not resist Prone or grapples.

details.flavorMarkdown: *A walking knot of stone carries veins of bright mineral through a body that sheds gravel with every step.*
details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Bedrock fist

**Target:** One visible creature within 2 squares. **Player defense:** Fortitude. **Damage type:** physical.

**Weak defense:** Push 3. **Standard defense:** Push 1.

**Limit:** Apply Stability, terrain costs and normal collision rules to the printed distance.

### Plant the Weight

*It spreads its stance and settles its weight into the ground.*

While standing on solid ground, gain Stability 3 until its next turn. Use the highest source only, never add sources.

### Lock the Frame

*The joints grind shut and the body becomes a single weight planted against the shove.*

Before this creature is forcibly moved while on solid ground, gain Stability 3 for that forced movement only. Use the highest source. In a collision chain, declare before its Stability is deducted; prior collision damage still resolves. This does not resist Prone or grapples.
details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 2; an explicit trait, not a bonus calculated from Size.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Plant its weight before pushing intruders away from the excavation. A visibly repaired breach can change its purpose.

**Encounter and conversation:** It is trying to close a wound cut through the hill by careless excavation.

**Habitat:** Disturbed elemental site · **Communication:** Common

**Loot:** Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

**Summoning:** Elemental 7 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/summons/earth-elemental.md).

## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-earth-elemental


**Category:** Elemental · **Role:** Displacer · **CV:** 37

### CV worksheet

**Reference damage:** 3/6/9

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.35

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.3 → 1.35: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.05. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=2.162, O=5.894. Uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md). Utility is provisional and does not simulate control, positioning or summon choices.

**Ability sources:** [brace ground](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/brace-ground.md), [driving blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/driving-blow.md), [Lock the Frame](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/lock-the-frame.md).

**Coverage reference:** [Pathfinder family survey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/family-survey.md); original HOL prose and mechanics.
